A Coherent Grid Traversal Algorithm for Volume Rendering
This research presents a novel coherent grid traversal algorithm designed to improve performance in direct volume rendering. Traditional techniques such as ray casting and shear-warp have limitations in terms of memory usage and computational efficiency, especially on modern architectures.
